title: Data-quality audit
question: How much of the catalog is usable for spatial and temporal inference?

title: Global blind spots of urban genomic surveillance
question: Is urban sequencing coverage geographically unequal relative to where people live?

title: Surveillance capacity and economic development
question: Do richer countries contribute more public urban sequencing per person?

title: COVID-19 and the structure of urban sequencing
question: Did the pandemic cause a level or trend break and a shift toward wastewater?

title: Habitat representation
question: Are some urban habitats systematically under-sampled?

title: Metadata completeness
question: Does completeness vary by assay region and release period?

title: Concentration in few centres
question: Do few research centres produce most urban sequencing data?

title: Diffusion of sequencing technologies
question: Do new technologies reach countries at different times and does lag track wealth?

title: Eligibility-screen benchmark
question: How accurate is the urban eligibility screen against expert labels?

title: Universal ecological structure
question: Does habitat explain more community variation than the city sampled?

title: Functional convergence
question: Are habitats more alike across cities in function than in taxonomy?

title: Scaling laws
question: Does effort-standardised richness scale as a power law of city population?

title: Prediction in unsampled cities
question: Do environmental and demographic features predict communities in held-out cities?

title: Human mobility and biogeography
question: Are cities linked by air travel more alike than distance and climate predict?

title: Cross-habitat connectivity
question: Do a city's habitats share taxa in non-random patterns?

title: Convergent molecular evolution
question: Do independent lineages in similar urban habitats show recurrent adaptive signatures? (MAGs + HyPhy selection scans)

title: Predictability of viral persistence
question: Do viral genomic features host and context predict repeated detection over time? (vOTU occupancy models)

title: Undiscovered diversity
question: Are discovery curves unsaturated with the largest gains in under-sampled regions?

title: Seasonality across climate zones
question: Do communities follow the local (hemisphere-aligned) season?

title: Urban AMR ecology
question: Do resistomes differ by habitat within cities and track taxonomy and development?

title: Urbanization-driven homogenization
question: Are urban communities less beta-diverse than non-urban ones of the same habitat? (needs a non-urban comparator cohort)

title: Resilience to disturbance
question: Do communities return to baseline after floods heatwaves or lockdowns? (event-aligned time series)

title: Climate change and redistribution
question: Are taxa shifting poleward or upslope over time? (ERA5-linked range models)
